# XHTML fixtures

Real consolidated texts downloaded from the Publications Office Cellar repository
(`http://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/{CELEX}`, English XHTML) on 2026-10-31.
EUR-Lex content may be reused with acknowledgement of the source; see the README. These are
documentation copies, not the authentic Official Journal texts. Larger files are gzipped.

| File | CELEX | Why it is here |
|---|---|---|
| `eprivacy_2006-05-03.xhtml` | 02002L0058-20060503 | Legacy markup (CONVEX 5.4), no element ids |
| `eprivacy_2009-12-19.xhtml` | 02002L0058-20091219 | Modern markup; real amendment pair with the file above |
| `eidas_2024-10-18.xhtml.gz` | 02014R0910-20241018 | Inline amendment markers (`►M2 ◄`), annexes, footnote refs |
| `eecc_2018-12-17.xhtml.gz` | 02018L1972-20181217 | Broken annex ids (Annex IX has id `anx_\xa0I`) |
| `avmsd_2010-05-05.xhtml.gz` | 02010L0013-20100505 | Legacy markup with chapter headings between articles, annexes |
| `universal_service_2020-12-21_repealed.xhtml` | 02002L0022-20201221 | Repeal notice with no text |
